experiment: Two full-scale, three-span (25 ft spans, 75 ft long) C and Z purlin roof systems with through-fastened steel deck were loaded to failure by uniform wind-uplift suction generated in a sealed vacuum chamber, with strain, displacement and bracing-strap (turnbuckle) instrumentation recorded at each load stage, plus three in-plane deck shear tests on a 10 ft section cut from the Z purlin specimen.
title: Full-Scale Wind Uplift Tests of Three-Span C and Z Purlin Roof Systems with Through-Fastened Steel Deck

variables.definition: Identifier assigned to each physical load test or failure event reported in the strength summary.
variables.name: Test identifier

variables.definition: Direction of the applied loading for each test (uplift, gravity or in-plane shear).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Purlin cross-section shape as printed on the construction drawings (C or Z).
variables.name: Purlin section type

variables.definition: Nominal web depth of the purlin taken from the construction drawings (8 in. for the Z, 7 in. for the C).
variables.name: Purlin web depth

variables.definition: Purlin base metal thickness as printed on the construction drawings; the C purlin has a thinner center span (0.073 in. corrected) and thicker exterior spans (0.119 in.).
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69; correction note on C-purlin center-span thickness (printed 't = 0.773' on Fig. 4, PDF p13)
variables.name: Purlin base metal thickness
variables.note: C center-span value corrected from printed 0.773 in. to 0.073 in. by the curator

variables.definition: Nominal span length between support beams of the continuous purlin specimen (actual Z-system spans 24'-10 1/2", 25'-0", 24'-10 1/2").
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69; header note on support beam spacing
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test specimen.
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test specimen.
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Type of roof panel and its attachment to the purlin flanges (through-fastened with No. 14 self-tapping sheet metal screws in all tests).
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69; deck attachment header note
variables.name: Deck panel / attachment type

variables.definition: Bracing arrangement of the purlin compression flange, including the 2.0 in. x 0.0625 in. steel straps welded to the flanges with turnbuckles at supports and at mid-span.
variables.name: Bracing arrangement
variables.note: Strap size 2.0 in. x 0.0625 in. is embedded in the text of this column

variables.definition: Maximum applied uniform uplift (vacuum) pressure sustained at failure, as printed in the report text.
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69 (failure_load_as_printed with failure_load_unit = psf)
variables.name: Failure uplift pressure
variables.note: Deck shear test rows are blank because only load-displacement curves are printed; dead-load inclusion not stated

variables.definition: Vacuum chamber pressure at failure expressed in inches of water as read from the water manometer.
variables.name: Vacuum pressure at failure
variables.note: Not printed for the Z purlin second (induced) failure

variables.definition: Failure moment column carried in the summary table; no moment values are reported by the paper.
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69 (failure_moment_as_printed / failure_moment_unit columns empty)
variables.name: Failure moment
variables.note: Column present but empty in every row

variables.definition: Description of the limit state that ended each test (e.g. buckle formed in the south span purlin, top flange buckled outward).
variables.name: Failure mode

variables.definition: Printed distance of the buckle from the nearest support beam, in feet and inches.
variables.name: Location of buckle from support

variables.definition: Center-to-center spacing of the two purlin lines in each specimen (5'-0").
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69; header note on purlin spacing
variables.name: Purlin spacing

variables.definition: Plan width of uplift pressure carried by each purlin line, computed by the curator as 8 in. from the purlin to the chamber edge plus half of the 5'-0" purlin spacing.
variables.evidence: Table S1 tributary width note (Cris Moen, open question MBMA_7603-Q01)
variables.name: Tributary width per purlin
variables.note: Not printed in the report; derived from Section 1 of the drawings

variables.definition: Failure load per purlin line obtained by multiplying the printed failure pressure (psf) by the 3.167 ft tributary width.
variables.evidence: Table S1, pages 6-8, 69; tributary width note
variables.name: Failure load per purlin line
variables.note: Applied vacuum load only; dead load not included

variables.definition: Overall length (75 ft) and sealed chamber width (6 ft 4 in.) of the three-span test specimens, stated in the loading header note.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on vacuum chamber construction, page 4 reference
variables.name: Specimen length and chamber width
variables.note: Stated in a note rather than as a column
symbols: (header note: 75 ft long, 6 ft 4 in. wide)

variables.definition: Sequential number of each recorded load stage in the uplift tests (Z test 1-16; C test continues from 17).
variables.evidence: Table A-1 page 73; Table B-1 page 82
variables.name: Load stage number

variables.definition: Uplift (vacuum) pressure held in the chamber at each recorded load stage of the Z and C purlin tests.
variables.evidence: Table A-1 page 73; Table B-1 page 82
variables.name: Load stage uplift pressure
variables.note: Load No. 13 printed as 31.6 psf in the log but 31.2 psf in the data tables; some C-test zero values printed as '0.[?]'

variables.definition: Printed narrative of the specimen and instrumentation condition (bracing tension, sensor status, failure events) at each load stage.
variables.evidence: Table A-1 page 73; Table B-1 page 82
variables.name: Load stage condition note
variables.note: Some notes are bracketed across several load stages

variables.definition: Number identifying each of the 48 strain gage / turnbuckle gage sensors installed on the Z purlin uplift specimen.
variables.name: Strain gage sensor number

variables.definition: Cross-section number along the Z purlin assembly at which each gage is located, per Fig. 2.
variables.name: Gage cross-section number

variables.definition: Letter giving the gage position within the cross section per the Fig. 2 detail sketches.
variables.name: Gage position letter
variables.note: Sensor 41 printed as 'E OR F*' with footnote that the position is uncertain

variables.definition: Offset dimension locating the strain gage within the purlin cross section, measured in inches.
variables.name: Gage offset dimension

variables.definition: Label stating whether the sweep reading is for the top or the bottom flange of the C purlin.
variables.evidence: Table in plan view of Fig. 4 (Sheet 4), page 13
variables.name: Sweep measurement location label
variables.note: Rows are not identified by purlin; labels repeat for the two purlins

variables.definition: Initial out-of-straightness (lateral offset from a string line) of the C purlin top or bottom flange measured at five stations along the length after erection.
variables.evidence: Table in plan view of Fig. 4 (Sheet 4), page 13
variables.name: Initial flange sweep
variables.note: The five measurement stations are not dimensioned on the drawing

variables.definition: Distance from the south end of the structure at which the deck screw offset was measured.
variables.name: Screw measurement station

variables.definition: As-built offset from the purlin web to the steel-deck attachment screw, measured for the east and west C purlins at each station.
variables.name: Deck screw offset from web
variables.note: Fractional inch values printed as fractions (e.g. 1 1/4)
